parameters.description:
`ifttt-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `ifttt` payload. The gateway composes the upstream IFTTT URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `events_secret` and `webhook_id_secret` parameters name the customer secrets holding this enrollment's IFTTT events and webhook id).
parameters.plus_base_url: ${ customer_secrets.IFTTT_BASE ?? https://maker.ifttt.com }/trigger/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.events_secret }} }/with/key/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }
parameters.summary: Relay a message to your own IFTTT by posting a native `ifttt` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

events_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ifttt events

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's ifttt webhook id
